classification.scoreJS: function(t){ if(!/parlor box #\d+/i.test(t)) return null; var sq=t.match(/\uD83D[\uDFE9\uDFE8\uDFE5]/g); if(!sq||sq.length!==3) return null; var g=0; for(var i=0;i<sq.length;i++){ if(sq[i]!=='\uD83D\uDFE5') g++; } return g+'/3'; }

classification.scoreJS: function(t){ if(!/4\u00D76 \u00B7|hankgreen\.com\/4x6/i.test(t)) return null; var m=t.match(/(\d+)\/(\d+) moves?/); if(!m) return null; var d=+m[1]-(+m[2]); var p=d===0?'on par':Math.abs(d)+(d<0?' under par':' over par'); var tiers=[['\uD83D\uDCAF','Perfect'],['\uD83E\uDD47','Gold'],['\uD83E\uDD48','Silver'],['\u2705','Solved'],['\uD83D\uDEDF','Rescued']]; for(var i=0;i<tiers.length;i++){ if(t.indexOf(tiers[i][0])>=0) return p+' \u00B7 '+tiers[i][1]; } return p; }
